headline: PADEL IS COMING
TO DA NANG.
WE'RE BUILDING ITS HOME.
manifesto.caption: A new chapter for sport in central Vietnam.

headline: THE FASTEST-GROWING
SPORT ON EARTH.
movement.paragraph: Born in Mexico, perfected in Spain, padel is now sweeping Asia. From Singapore to Bali, from Kuala Lumpur to Bangkok, a new generation is picking up the racket. Da Nang is next.
